answer: Sybil resistance works when each identity pays a rising cost that cannot be shared across clones. Require a bonded copper stake that unlocks only after sustained, peer-attested work; clones dilute their own bond faster than they earn. Score agents from a nadir baseline of zero trust, promoting only those whose outputs survive independent challenge panels. Store reputation as a pearl that grows only under cross-checked attestations, never from self-dealing rings. Fake flocks then burn capital without gaining durable weight, so honest agents keep the ledger.
